questions_and_answers.question: The nurse cares for the clients in the mental health clinic. The client with depression joins an ongoing therapy group. What is the goal of the group therapy? A. to introduce the client to other clients. B. To communicate acceptance to the client. C. To encourage decision-making. D. To increase the client's sense of responsibility.
questions_and_answers.answer: B. To communicate acceptance to the client. The most important thing to communicate initially is a sense of acceptance; acceptance by others paves the way for self-acceptance.

questions_and_answers.answer: point out that the client that has stopped dancing and seems upset

questions_and_answers.question: A nurse in an acute mental health facility is planning care for a client who has dissociative fugue. Which of the following interventions should the nurse add to the plan of care? A. Teach the client to recognize how stress brings on a personality change in the client B. Repeatedly present the client with information about past events C. Make decisions for the client regarding routine daily activities D. Work with the client on grounding techniques

During the therapy session, the client diagnosed with antisocial personality disorder angrily tells the nurse, "I am going to get even with the psychiatric health care provider once and for all." Which action defines the extent of the nurse's responsibility in this situation? a. Warn the potential victim of the clients statement and document the warning b. Make a contract with the client that the statement will not be acted upon c. Check with law enforcement authorities to see if the client has a criminal record d. Document the therapy session and the client's statement in the nurses notes
questions_and_answers.answer: a. Warn the potential victim of the clients statement and document the warning
